name: Signeasy
description: Check contract status, recent activity, and signer progress using natural language. See which contract need your action, are waiting on others, or have been completed. Get quick visibility into who has signed and who is still pending, so you can stay on top of contract workflows without switching tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Signeasy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Signeasy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.signeasy.com/mcp/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Signeasy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signeasy lists 27 MCP tools, including signeasy_aggregate_contracts, signeasy_cancel_request, signeasy_count_contracts, signeasy_create_signature_request, signeasy_create_signature_request_preview, signeasy_get_account_info, signeasy_get_account_summary, signeasy_get_contract_details, signeasy_get_contract_field_values, signeasy_get_document_download_url, signeasy_get_document_signers, and signeasy_get_pending_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Signeasy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Signeasy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Signeasy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Signeasy is developed by Signeasy. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
